name: Banarasi Kaddu
ingredients: Methi seeds, jeera, saunf, ginger, chilli and amchur
steps: Temper jeera, methi and saunf in oil.
Add pumpkin and spices; cover until soft.
Mash a little pumpkin to thicken; add amchur.
note: No jaggery or sugar needed; pumpkin still contains carbohydrate.

inspirationReferences.title: Kaddu ki Sabji (Easy Pumpkin Recipe)
inspirationReferences.note: Pumpkin cooking, methi-cumin tempering and amchur finish; our chana-dal Banarasi-inspired version is distinct.
